Pastor Toolkit

You’re already welcome here—weekly prep gathered in one porch light, without measuring your worth.

Search Scripture, build sermons and lessons, lead your church—tools that hold the work lightly so your heart can stay with the text.

Pastor Hub Build a Sermon

Try a topic — tap any button to load verses

More topics

Build from a topic

Enter a topic (e.g. hope, fear, anxiety). The site can find verses and sketch an outline for the Sermon Builder—optional when the blank page feels loud, not an obligation.

Preaching & sermon prep

From text to outline to delivery.

Topic search

Find verses by theme (hope, fear, obedience, grace). Use the search bar above or pick a topic chip.

Verse of the Day

Daily verse, reflection, and prayer—use as a preaching seed or personal anchor.

Chapter reader

Read full chapters in context. Red-letter option for words of Jesus.

Sermon Builder

Title, theme, primary text, outline, application, prayer. Export a standard PDF, a room handout (larger type + discussion lines), or a small-group lesson pack (OIA-shaped). Everything is local until you choose to share.

Sermon & lesson templates

Pre-built templates to jumpstart your next message or lesson.

Teaching & lessons

Lessons, curriculum, and age-specific content.

Study Workspace / Lesson Builder

Notes, saved verses, collections. Build lessons, export to PDF, share links. Curriculum builder and bulk export.

Kids Coloring & Family Activities

Coloring, prompts, and Bible stories for Sunday school or family ministry.

7-Day & custom reading plans

Ready-made 7-day plan or create a custom 7/14/21/30-day plan for a class or small group.

Shareable topic pages

Send your congregation to focused pages: Grief, Anxiety, Hope, Fear, Forgiveness, Strength, Parenting.

Church & congregation

Lead your church with verse, prayer, and assignments.

Church Center

Set your church verse of the day, shared prayer list, assign reading to groups. Add weekly sermons. Find your church.

Prayer

Post encouragement, share verses, or point people to a calm place for community prayer.

Church-branded verse cards

On Church plan: create shareable verse images with your church name. Use from home or Study Workspace.

Content & communication

Emails, graphics, and shareable content.

Weekly email template

Copy-paste template for a short weekly encouragement to your list.

Verse cards & share image

From the daily battle or Study Workspace: create a shareable verse image (with optional church name on Church plan).

Bulk export to PDF

In Study Workspace: export all saved verses and notes to one PDF for handouts or personal use.

Study & personal prep

Your own study flow and devotion.

Notes & saved verses

Save verses and private notes. Sync across devices when signed in. Use for sermon prep or quiet time.

Before you stand up

A short prayer for pastors.

Lord, open Your Word to me so I may serve Your people with clarity and love. Guard my heart from pride; fill my mouth with truth. Let this message come from You, for Your glory. Amen.
